_comment: Course Study App — Single Lecture Slide Deck Index Template (30-50 slides). Keys are bare PDF filenames. Every physical slide from 1 to total_slides must have an entry in pageMap without skipping.

markdown_and_latex_support.note: ALL STRING FIELDS (title, author, description, pageMap[].title, pageMap[].section) SUPPORT GITHUB-FLAVORED MARKDOWN AND KATEX MATH ($inline$ or $$display$$).
markdown_and_latex_support.mandatory_json_backslash_rule: CRITICAL: In JSON strings, the backslash '\' is an escape character. Every LaTeX command MUST use double backslashes '\\'. Example: '$\alpha$', '$\text{ms}$', '$$\frac{a}{b}$$', '$\mathcal{O}(N \log N)$'. Escape literal dollar signs in prose as \$.
markdown_and_latex_support.code_and_math_rules: Use backticks (`$var`) exclusively for code and variables; use dollar signs ($math$) exclusively for LaTeX math.

_schema_field_definitions.id: String. Unique kebab-case identifier used for internal system references and citations.
_schema_field_definitions.title: MARKDOWN & LATEX STRING FIELD. Full descriptive title of the lecture deck.
_schema_field_definitions.author: MARKDOWN & LATEX STRING FIELD. Instructor(s), department, or institution.
_schema_field_definitions.description: MARKDOWN & LATEX STRING FIELD. 1-2 sentence synopsis of key concepts covered.
_schema_field_definitions.total_slides: Integer. Total physical sheets in the PDF.
_schema_field_definitions.total_pages: Integer or Null. Total numbered presentation slides, or null if unnumbered.
_schema_field_definitions.pageMap: Array of SlideNode objects. Strictly sequential: slide 1 to total_slides.
_schema_field_definitions.pageMap[].page: Integer or Null. Logical/printed slide number on the slide.
_schema_field_definitions.pageMap[].title: MARKDOWN & LATEX STRING FIELD. Disambiguated, meaningful slide topic title.
_schema_field_definitions.pageMap[].section: MARKDOWN & LATEX STRING FIELD. Module or thematic group name.
